Submission Description: (doc-less) Motion to Intervene of ON Energy Storage, Inc. under ER26-3650-000.

Submission Date:        9/18/2026 8:29:27 AM

Filed Date:             9/18/2026 8:30:00 AM

Dockets
-------
ER26-3650-000        Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-08-28_Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads submitted on 8/28/2026 4:41:03 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
ON Energy Storage, Inc.                  lucas.fykes@on.energy                                                            

Basis for Intervening:
ON Energy Storage, Inc. (“ON.energy”) supplies and operates hyperscale power systems, including medium-voltage uninterruptible power supply technology designed to support the interconnection and reliable operation of large computational loads and data centers. ON.energy participated in MISO’s Large Load Working Group process concerning large load voltage and frequency ride-through requirements and submitted comments on MISO’s proposed revisions to BPM-032, Section 11.

The large load interconnection reliability requirements at issue in this proceeding may directly affect ON.energy’s commercial and technical interests and the deployment of its technology. ON.energy’s participation will provide technical and commercial experience relevant to the issues presented in this proceeding. ON.energy does not take a position on the merits of MISO’s filing at this time.
